articles.title: Australia appoints first female army chief
articles.summary: Australia's government has announced a significant reshuffle in its military leadership, making history by appointing the first woman to the Chief of Army position. This landmark decision marks a pivotal moment for the Australian Defence Force, signalling progressive changes and breaking traditional barriers within its ranks. The move reflects evolving inclusion and diversity in national defence.

articles.title: ZUPPA Geo Navigation Technologies delivers 500 Ajeet drones to the Indian Army
articles.summary: Chennai-based ZUPPA Geo Navigation Technologies has supplied over 500 Ajeet series drones to the Indian Army in the last three months. This significant delivery by an indigenous manufacturer enhances the Army's operational capabilities, especially in reconnaissance and surveillance, marking a boost for 'Make in India' defence initiatives and strengthening our forces' technological edge.
